name: PARTNR
summary: 面向家庭场景人机协作规划与推理的大规模具身基准，通过仿真闭环生成并验证具有空间、时间和异构智能体能力约束的自然语言任务。
summaryEn: A large embodied benchmark for planning and reasoning in household human-robot collaboration, with simulation-grounded language tasks containing spatial, temporal, and heterogeneous-agent constraints.
scaleZh: 10 万项任务 · 60 套房屋 · 5819 个独特物体
license: Official repository terms apply; underlying Habitat assets may differ
licenseZh: 适用官方仓库条款；底层 Habitat 资源许可可能不同
access: Official benchmark planner and task resources available
accessZh: 提供官方基准规划器和任务资源
wmNote: 多智能体约束、任务跟踪和错误恢复可诊断长期规划能力，但任务由半自动流程生成且依赖仿真。
wmNoteEn: Multi-agent constraints, task tracking, and error recovery diagnose long-horizon planning, though tasks are semi-automatically generated and simulation-dependent.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2411.00081] PARTNR: A Benchmark for Planning and Reasoning in Embodied Multi-agent Tasks
evidence.statement: Simulator-grounded household collaboration tasks execute agents under temporal/spatial constraints; task specifications are not recorded trajectories.
